items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: When Milly Bones, I played with Milly Bones, that was Johnny Brown's band.

ctx.x: Who was playing with Chris Kelly when you were playing? Who was on time there? Zeb Miller. Zeb Lanois? Yeah, Zeb. What about, aren't you Milly Bones supposed to have played with Chris Kelly? Maybe he played with him a little bit.

Well, now that was a different band. When Milly Bones, I played with Milly Bones, that was Johnny Brown's band. And Johnny Brown was a kind of involuntary. Milly was the better kind of up there, so he used to use Milly Bones and himself in his own band. That was Johnny Brown's band. And their regular trombone player was Mr. Harris. But most times on the weekend, he was a baller maker. And they called him overtime. Well, he didn't steal his job, you know. And he'd always get me to go in his place. Johnny Brown's…
